fix(runtime): stop the node shim from looping on a global pnpmfile (#17534)

Installing a pinned runtime from the node shim loaded the global
pnpmfile. Its hook worker is started as `node`, which resolves to the
same shim, so every level re-entered runtime provisioning, waited on
the slot lock, installed privately and spawned another worker. `node`
and `pnpm install` hung and left orphaned workers behind.

The hardened runtime install config now sets ignore_pnpmfile, like it
already disables scripts and dependency rewrites. Project installs
still run the global pnpmfile.

Closes pnpm/pnpm#17530

Co-authored-by: lazerg <lazerg2@gmail.com>
